The site is Weigh & Refill Zero Waste Pantry — Click & Collect Bulk Staples, a web-shop web application for Bring-your-own-container bulk dry goods orders.

Owner brief: "Our zero-waste grocery cooperative sells bulk grains, pulses, and olive oils where customers bring their own reusable jars. We need a pre-pack ordering app where shoppers choose dry goods by weight in grams, select jar drop-off times, and receive an order slip. Orders must be stored on the server so that reloading the checkout confirmation route retains the jar refill list."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-18/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Weigh & Refill Zero Waste Pantry — Click & Collect Bulk Staples: the page for bring-your-own-container bulk dry goods orders, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #78350f (wr-kraft), #15803d (wr-green), #ffffff (wr-card), #e7e5e4 (wr-border), #fafaf9 (wr-bg), #292524 (wr-text), #78716c (wr-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--wr-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a price or total that cannot be traced back to a listed item; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Weigh & Refill Zero Waste Pantry — Click & Collect Bulk Staples as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Shopper name", "Email address", "Bulk staple", "Weight in grams", "Collection window", "Itemized refill list").

User journey context: Browse bulk staples, specify desired gram weight, and add items to the refill basket. Review the basket totals, enter shopper contact information, and select a collection window. Complete checkout, view the order pickup number, and reload the page to verify persistence.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
